description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001 (24/0731)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (No. 12, 13 and 14 of Block 07) in Homagama, including detailed particulars about the land extent, ownership details, and registration information. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
